feature: The combo mark on deck rows (card rows addendum L1, PR 2): a card's two-card combo partner in this deck, drawn as the last mark on the one-line row, folding with the facts, and glossed in the deck's mark key
note: PRECONDITION: the deck (`COMBO_DECK`) must hold both pieces of at least one two-card combo, or no row draws the glyph and the sheet reads as coverage. The heavy row needs a card with three bracket facts and an in-deck partner, so its combo mark is the fourth mark and folds into the wide tier's +1. On local-dev's HD - Gishath, Polyraptor pairs with Marauding Raptor and Forerunner of the Empire; give it three facts on a scratch branch of local-dev (insert its `card_bracket_flags` row there only). The first row's throwaway visit absorbs the About gate.

shares.note: The deck row draws the browse hosts' combo mark as-is, with the deck scope.
